sources.title: Guardant wins FDA approval for updated liquid biopsy
sources.claim: Guardant Health secured FDA approval for next-generation liquid biopsy panel profiling 740+ genes; Shield approved Jul 29, 2024 for CRC screening with 83% sensitivity
data_points: FDA approval date: July 2024
Shield sensitivity: 83% for colorectal cancer detection
Shield specificity: 90% for advanced neoplasia
New panel: 740+ genes vs previous 74

First AI-designed oncology drug entering human trials 2025
AI drug discovery sector: $3.3B venture funding in 2024
AlphaFold3 used for protein-drug binding prediction

sources.title: Precision oncology in advanced cancer patients improves overall survival with lower weekly healthcare costs
sources.claim: Matched precision oncology therapy: 51.7 weeks median survival vs 25.8 weeks standard care; $2,720/week vs $3,453/week cost
data_points: Precision matched therapy: 51.7 weeks median overall survival
Standard care: 25.8 weeks median overall survival
Targeted treatment cost: $2,720/week
Control group cost: $3,453/week
Better outcomes at 21% lower cost per week

sources.title: Navigating the EU AI Act: implications for regulated digital medical products
sources.claim: EU AI Act classifies all AI systems in medical devices regulated under MDR or IVDR as high-risk AI; high-risk obligations apply 24-36 months after May 2025 entry into force
data_points: All oncology AI diagnostics classified as high-risk AI
General-purpose AI obligations: 12 months post May 2025
High-risk AI obligations: 24-36 months post May 2025
Extraterritorial scope: US manufacturers whose AI is used by EU providers are in scope

sources.claim: ASCO 2026 focus on translating AI-driven precision oncology to real-world impact; growing emphasis on AI for missed patient identification and therapy uptake in real-world settings
data_points: ASCO 2026 theme: real-world translation of AI precision oncology
AI improving diagnostic adoption and missed patient identification
Precision medicine market forecast: $126B in 2026, $237B by 2031
